source: Earth Observation Group, Colorado School of Mines — Global Gas Flaring Observed from Space
calibrationNote: Volumes come from EOG's radiant-heat calibration, which EOG reports overestimates SMALL flares — where almost all of this catalog sits. Treat every kW figure as an upper-leaning estimate, not a measurement.

idCrosswalk.note: EOG publishes a cross-year flare id from the 2023 edition. It is compared against the 500 m spatial merge and REPORTED, never used to re-link a site: the ids do not exist before 2023, so adopting them would mean two different identity rules inside one catalog.
